name: Brekkedammen ved Frysja
representationLock: The canonical identity is the named municipal bathing/recreation place at upper Akerselva. The weir, reservoir and nearby industrial heritage are physical layers of the site but none may silently redefine the whole bathing-place identity.

officialIdentitySource.name: Oslo kommune – Brekkedammen ved Frysja
officialIdentitySource.finding: Oslo kommune identifies Brekkedammen ved Frysja as a popular bathing place in the upper Akerselva.

rejectedAsWholeSiteAnchors.reason: Exact named physical object, but it represents the weir itself rather than the complete municipal bathing/recreation site. It is also only 25.2 m from the existing Brekke power-station place.
